sources.title: GLM (AI) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: GLM, short for General Language Model, is a series of open weight large language models developed by Chinese software company Z.ai. Though the first GLM model was published on 3 March 2021, it was released under the name ChatGLM as an AI -based chatbot in March 2023.
